H_FLOOR.criterion: min clearance / radius >= -0.2; no grain below -0.2 r

H_INT.criterion: max rel. diff of stored vs recomputed r_p995 / r_max <= 1e-9 (full archives)

H_METRIC.criterion: median over full archives of 1-sigma(r_p995 | 25% random subsample) / R_out >= 0.03

H_SUB.criterion: stride-4 p995 spread <= 0.01 of R_out, every full archive
